blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez has an aide who is on call 24 hours a day to attend to his medical needs, a Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) official told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Monday. BJMP Chief Superintendent Maria Lourdes Pacion clarified her earlier testimony that Romualdez’s aide, Arvin de Guzman, stayed inside the detention facility 24/7. During Monday’s hearing, Pacion explained that she meant De Guzman was available around the clock when needed, but was physically inside the facility only from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. READ: Over P27-B projects allegedly inserted for Romualdez […]...
